LanguageData.LP_Dretch.label: manes
LanguageData.LP_Dretch.description: The lowest demons of the Abyss: squat, ashen, reeking of rot, with just enough brain to follow the simplest orders. Manes are best summoned as laborers: hauling, mining, cleaning, and good for nothing else. Anyone within 2 cells of them is put in a worse mood by the stench.
LanguageData.LP_Dretch.descriptionShort: The lowest demon of the Abyss. Only does menial work, work speed ×0.8, foul stench; banished when downed.
LanguageData.LP_Barlgura.label: barlgura
LanguageData.LP_Barlgura.description: An ape-like abyssal demon with brute strength under orange-brown fur. A barlgura can leap onto an enemy up to 8 cells away and knock down those around; standing still, it melts into the shadows. It likes watching others bleed.
LanguageData.LP_Barlgura.descriptionShort: Ape demon. Melee +20%, carry capacity +40%, leap strike, invisible when still; banished when downed (except bound ones).
LanguageData.LP_Hezrou.label: hezrou
LanguageData.LP_Hezrou.description: A toad-like abyssal demon with thick, tough, warty green-grey hide. The hezrou's stench makes enemies within 3 cells too nauseous to hold their weapons; it is as at home in water as in mud.
LanguageData.LP_Hezrou.descriptionShort: Toad demon. Sharp/blunt armor +20%, stench nauseates enemies, moves freely in water; banished when downed (except bound ones).
LanguageData.LP_Succubus.label: succubus
LanguageData.LP_Succubus.description: Abyssal demons that feed on seduction; females are called succubi, males incubi. They have bat wings, thin tails and small horns, and can shapeshift into ordinary people to blend into crowds. A charming kiss leaves victims defenseless, and whoever shares their bed at night has their energy drained. Succubi can have children with mortals; the children are cambions.
LanguageData.LP_Succubus.descriptionShort: Playable demon. Shapeshift disguise, charming kiss, dream drain; fire/toxin resistance, social +25%; fears altars and holy symbols; children are cambions.
LanguageData.LP_Nabassu.label: nabassu
LanguageData.LP_Nabassu.description: A gargoyle-like abyssal demon: grey-black stone skin, bat wings, long fangs. Nabassus hunt souls: the souls of those it kills are devoured and can never be resurrected, and it grows stronger with each one. Its gaze can make limbs stiff as stone.
LanguageData.LP_Nabassu.descriptionShort: Soul-eating demon. Its victims cannot be resurrected, soul-gorged stacks build up, petrifying gaze; banished when downed (except bound ones).
LanguageData.LP_ShadowDemon.label: shadow demon
LanguageData.LP_ShadowDemon.description: An incorporeal abyssal demon, like a human-shaped black shadow. Ordinary weapons only deal half damage to it; but it fears light: standing in bright areas it takes ×1.5 damage and moves slower. Shadow demons only come out of abyssal rifts at night and cannot be summoned or bound.
LanguageData.LP_ShadowDemon.descriptionShort: Night enemy. Non-magic weapon damage halved; in light takes ×1.5 damage, move speed ×0.7.
LanguageData.LP_Cambion.label: cambion
LanguageData.LP_Cambion.description: Children of demons and mortals, or mortals who became demons after being fully soaked by the Abyss. Cambions have horns, small bat wings and golden-red eyes; they fear no fire and instinctively know how to make others afraid or obedient. Cambions are mortal-born and are never banished. The bloodline is inheritable.
LanguageData.LP_Cambion.descriptionShort: Inheritable. Cold iron ×1.25, abyssal taint ×0.5, fire ×0.5, gliding leap, social talent.
